```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(osmdata)

source(here("R", "od_io.R"))
```

```{r build-od-parquet}
# The raw OD CSVs are far larger than memory (bus: ~18 GB in total), so we do
# not load them all at once. Instead, every monthly CSV in data/raw/OD/ is
# converted once into a Parquet dataset in data/processed/od_parquet/
# (about 8x smaller on disk). Months already converted are skipped, so this
# chunk is slow only the first time and after new months are downloaded.
build_od_parquet()

od  <- open_od() # lazy: nothing is read into memory yet
```

```{r load-od-2020}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfB23 <- c(202303, 202306, 202309, 202312)
dfB24 <- c(202403, 202406, 202409, 202412)
dfB25 <- c(202503, 202506, 202509, 202512)
dfB26 <- c(202603, 202606, 202609)

od_bus_2023 <- od %>% 
  filter(MODE == "bus", YYYYMM %in% dfB23) %>% 
  collect()

od_bus_2024 <- od %>% 
  filter(MODE == "bus", YYYYMM %in% dfB24) %>% 
  collect()

od_bus_2025 <- od %>% 
  filter(MODE == "bus", YYYYMM %in% dfB25) %>% 
  collect()

od_bus_2026 <- od %>% 
  filter(MODE == "bus", YYYYMM %in% dfB26) %>% 
  collect()

total_bus <- bind_rows(od_bus_2023, od_bus_2024, od_bus_2025, od_bus_2026)
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson"))
busStops <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "LTABusStop.geojson"))

subzone  <- st_transform(subzone, crs = 3414)
busStops <- st_transform(busStops, crs = 3414)

peakHour <- c(6,7,8,9,17,18,19,20)

area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r}
busStops_center <- busStops %>%
  st_filter(
    subzone %>% filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_center),
    .predicate = st_intersects
  )

busStops_jurong <- busStops %>%
  st_filter(
    subzone %>% filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong),
    .predicate = st_intersects
  )

busStops_woodlands <- busStops %>%
  st_filter(
    subzone %>% filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands),
    .predicate = st_intersects
  )

busStops_tampines <- busStops %>%
  st_filter(
    subzone %>% filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines),
    .predicate = st_intersects
  )
```

```{r}
od_bus_2023 <- od_bus_2023 %>%
  filter(
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% peakHour) |
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY")
  )

od_bus_2024 <- od_bus_2024 %>%
  filter(
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% peakHour) |
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY")
  )

od_bus_2025 <- od_bus_2025 %>%
  filter(
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% peakHour) |
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY")
  )

od_bus_2026 <- od_bus_2026 %>%
  filter(
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% peakHour) |
    (DAY_TYPE == "WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY")
  )

am_peak <- c(6,7,8,9)
pm_peak <- c(17,18,19,20)
```

```{r}
dict_hub_stop <- bind_rows(
  busStops_center %>% mutate(zone = "CBD"),
  busStops_tampines %>% mutate(zone = "Tampines"),
  busStops_jurong %>% mutate(zone = "Jurong East"),
  busStops_woodlands %>% mutate(zone = "Woodlands")
    ) %>% 
  select(BUS_STOP_NUM, zone)

hubs_bus <- bind_rows(od_bus_2023, od_bus_2024,od_bus_2025, od_bus_2026)

rm(od_bus_2023, od_bus_2024, od_bus_2025, od_bus_2026)
```

```{r}
dest_flows_am <- hubs_bus %>% 
  filter(DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY", TIME_PER_HOUR %in% am_peak) %>% 
  inner_join(dict_hub_stop, by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM"))

attraction_monthly_am <- dest_flows_am %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, zone) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_arrivals = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS),
    .groups = "drop"
    )

total_dest_flows_am <- total_bus %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH) %>% 
  filter(DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY", TIME_PER_HOUR %in% am_peak) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_island_trips = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS),
    .groups = "drop"
    )
```

```{r}
bus_share_am <- attraction_monthly_am %>% 
  left_join(total_dest_flows_am, by = "YEAR_MONTH") %>% 
  mutate(am_share = total_arrivals / total_island_trips) %>% 
  arrange(YEAR_MONTH, zone)

cbd_outflow_share <- total_bus %>% 
  filter(DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY", TIME_PER_HOUR %in% am_peak) %>% 
  inner_join(dict_hub_stop, by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")) %>% 
  rename(original_zone = zone) %>% 
  filter(original_zone %in% c("Jurong East", "Tampines", "Woodlands", "CBD")) %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, original_zone) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_departures = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS),
    trips_to_cbd = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS[DESTINATION_PT_CODE %in% busStops_center$BUS_STOP_NUM]),
    .groups = "drop"
   ) %>% 
  mutate(
    cbd_share_pct = trips_to_cbd / total_departures * 100
   )
```

```{r}
arrivals <- attraction_monthly_am %>%
  select(YEAR_MONTH, zone, total_arrivals)

departures <- cbd_outflow_share %>%
  select(YEAR_MONTH, original_zone, total_departures) %>%
  rename(zone = original_zone)

in_out_ratio_after23 <- arrivals %>% 
  left_join(departures, by = c("YEAR_MONTH", "zone")) %>% 
  mutate(in_out_ratio = total_arrivals / total_departures)
```

```{r}
trip_distance_summary <- total_bus %>%
  filter(DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY", TIME_PER_HOUR %in% am_peak) %>%
  inner_join(dict_hub_stop, by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")) %>%
  rename(dest_zone = zone) %>%
  filter(dest_zone %in% c("Jurong East", "Tampines", "Woodlands", "CBD")) %>%
  left_join(
    busStops %>% select(BUS_STOP_NUM, geometry_orig = geometry),
    by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    busStops %>% select(BUS_STOP_NUM, geometry_dest = geometry),
    by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")  
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    distance_km = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry_orig, geometry_dest, by_element = TRUE)) / 1000
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(distance_km)) %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, dest_zone) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_arrivals = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS),
    weighted_avg_dist_km = sum(distance_km * TOTAL_TRIPS) / total_arrivals,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
